bigmodel-legacy@2026-10-16.note: V2 personal plans: approx. prompts per 5 hours and per week (最多约); GLM-5.3 1× off-peak / 3× peak, GLM-5.3-Flash 0.4× / 1.2×; peak Mon–Fri 14:00–18:00 UTC+8; weekends off-peak all day.

glm-legacy@2026-10-16.note: Legacy Plan V2: approx. prompts per 5 hours and per week; GLM-5.3 1× off-peak / 3× peak, GLM-5.3-Flash 0.4× / 1.2×; peak Mon–Fri 14:00–18:00 UTC+8; weekends off-peak all day.

bigmodel-overview@2026-10-16.note: MCP 消耗积分数 = 调用次数 × Output 抵扣系数; 联网搜索, 网页读取 and 开源仓库 are 1.2 each. The off-peak 50% applies to model calls only.

glm-overview@2026-10-16.note: MCP tool credit usage = number of calls × output multiplier; Web Search, Web Reader and Zread are 1.2 each. The off-peak 50% applies to model usage only.

zcode-config@2026-10-16.note: data.configs.codingPlanBillingDiscount, zh-CN infoBody: 用户在 ZCode 中通过 Coding Plan 调用模型时，额度消耗全周期按 0.67 系数折算。……具体折算规则和额度权益截止时间以官网公告为准。No end date is published.

kiro-models@2026-10-16.note: Cost is relative to Auto (1.0x baseline); GPT-5.6 requests over 272K tokens are billed at double the listed rate (Sol 8.8x, Terra 4.4x, Luna 1.2x).

kiro-pricing@2026-10-16.note: Monthly credits: Free 50, Pro 1,000, Pro+ 2,000, Pro Max 5,000, Power 10,000; add-on credits $0.04 each on paid plans.

copilot-plans@2026-10-16.note: Total monthly AI credits: Pro 1,500, Pro+ 7,000, Max 20,000; Business 1,900 and Enterprise 3,900 per user, pooled per billing entity; 1 AI credit = $0.01; usage beyond the allowance is billed at the per-token rates.

cursor-current-models-pricing@2026-10-16.note: Cursor models (Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, Composer 2.5) draw from the weekly pool at unpublished rates; these per-million-token rates apply when buying additional usage beyond the pool.

copilot-legacy-multipliers@2026-10-16.note: Not a monitored source (SHA-256 of the fetched page). Applies only to annual Pro and Pro+ subscribers who stayed on premium requests after 2026-06-01; auto model selection takes 10% off.
